notes.text: A linear regulator with a capacitor on its input and on its output.
Twelve test pads, one for each free pin of the plug. They are in a module only so that the physical file can name them together (`.pads.place.side`).
The plug-in radio carrier's two socket rows, 10 contacts each, and its supply capacitor.
Three indicator LEDs, each with its own series resistor.
